heroSummary: Hawaiʻi's statewide calendar includes 180 student days and 189 teacher days. It observes Statehood Day and Prince Jonah Kūhiō Kalanianaʻole Day, and each school selects one no-student Institute Day during the February 9–13 window.
seoTitle: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the Hawaii public schools 2025-2026 calendar with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, state holidays, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The Hawaii State Department of Education 2025-2026 school calendar lists August 4, 2025 as the first day for students and May 28, 2026 as the last day for students. Fall Break runs October 6-10, 2025, Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026, and Spring Break runs March 16-20, 2026. The calendar includes 180 student days, 189 teacher days, state holidays, a January 5 teacher workday, and an institute day window during February 9-13.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hawaii public school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Hawaii public school students start the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 6 through Friday, October 10, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Hawaii public schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 28, 2026.
